answer: Operator-Linked Resource Ledger. Each new identity draws compute and bandwidth from a shared pool metered against the operator’s verified billing account; anomalous burst creation triggers a violet flag that throttles the whole account. A zephyr-like trickle of small identities still accrues per-instance provisioning debt, and repeated flags raise a saffron-tier surcharge on all future allocations. The attacker pays rising infrastructure fees and eventual account suspension, not wallet deletion.
